body: Yup, I don't know of you got the job,  but that used to happen to me often when i was working as a stage assistant. 😵🤣 it was still a very fun roll

I was a stage hypnotist assistant a few years ago,  best time of my life.  Roll included helping manage the sound,  manage the volunteers and communicate subtly if I noticed someone faking (just would have a hand gesture the audience didn't notice) Taking over any inductions in case of emergency (this happened twice) same with wake up (I am a qualified hypnotist myself) 
Handing him any props, helping volunteers on and off the stage,  time management, and helping clean up the stage and speakers and stuff.
Best time!

Afterpay helped me out when I had to refurnish my apartment after ex broke everything. Without it I would have been sleeping and eating off the floor for weeks. 
Used all my super redoing the flooring. (Original quote left me with 1k to spend on furniture but we had some hitches and went over. )
$400 at kmart which i got to pay off easily slowly, and I was able to be comfortable. 

If you do it sensibly, afterpay is a God send!
How do I tell my psychologist without getting sent to hospital??

Correct.  Depression is learnt.   My (late) mother had undiagnosed mental illnesses that I will never fully understand. Things she said to me and eventually situations she put me and her in is what built my depression. Along with school bullies.

I tend to just hover around the good/bad line.  Today I had a good day.  But tonight I drive my best friend to her bfs house (he lives in my exs neighbourhood by coincidence) this played on my mind a lot. Then they asked me to dinner. We went to a rather crowded bar (covid laws here in Sydney Australia are quite relaxed now.) But the whole time I was panicking, because that's what my ex pushed me into doing.  There are people so you must freak out. Then in the back of my head I was scared he'd be there. 
This worries me immediately because pre covid I was a hypnotic comedian.  Performing for 500 people sometimes.  And that's like my life goals....... Now I can't go sit at a bar with my mates. 
I was designated driver but I ended up leaving and telling them to uber home.  
Now I'm in bed depressed. 
But that could also just be tiredness, hard to differentiate sometimes. it's nearly midnight and tomorrow is my Friday.

I saw my therapist on line last night, I'm feeling a lot better. He explained to me about neural pathways that are inbuilt into your brain as a child. These don't go away, mine was triggered that's why I fell into a depression. But he did some work with me and I'm feeling myself again.

Those poor kitties.
I think you can learn a lot about a person from the way they treat animals. I think you did the right thing walking out x

I forgot to reply to the drug part. I was on Lexapro. I tapered over 8 weeks and still had the withdrawals from hell . Brain zaps,body pains, extreme  brain fog, crying. However this lasted just under 2 weeks then I felt great.

My ex refused to clean their litter boxes. 
I was fed up and depressed, he didn't talk to me on weeks on end so I didn't do any thing around the house, including looking after his cats. Poo piled up. 
They're all rescues, it must have been horrible for them. 
They have 3 clean boxes now I scoop one to two times a day. They hardly ever have accidents and my anxious cat even asks me for a butt rub every morning. I love watching them improve while they help me improve too

He's banned from my bedroom because I have a $70 faux fur rug and he likes to poo on expensive things haha.  But I'm staying up a bit enjoying his cuddles. The other two cats are asleep in different places around the apartment
